shot: SL-21 B: beach excuse clip (Short 2), second version
intent: A heavy, sunburnt, scruffy man leans on a wooden beach lounger on a tropical beach, facing the camera, chest up, Hawaiian shirt, sunglasses on his head. START: his right hand (picture left) holds a pineapple cocktail in front of his chest; his left forearm lies along the wooden rail in front of him with the hand hanging at picture left; sorry-for-himself pout, mouth closed. END: he has lifted his left arm off the rail and holds the hand open, palm up, beside his left shoulder (picture right) in a whiny shrug, head tilted, eyebrows raised, mouth closed; the right hand and the cocktail have not moved. Beach, sea, palms and lounger do not move. The clip will be lip-synced later, so the mouth is closed in both frames. MOTION (about 3.4 s): locked camera; he holds the look, then lifts his left arm off the rail, palm up beside his shoulder, and tilts his head; the cocktail hand stays put. Palm fronds sway and small waves roll. Mouth stays closed (lips are synced afterwards).

person.compare_why: a shrug lifts the shoulders and pulls the shoulder landmarks toward the neck; hips and legs are hidden; head width (ear-to-ear and outer-eye mean) is the size measure a chest-up shrug leaves valid, and the head tilts but does not turn

hands.right: holds the pineapple cocktail in the same place in both frames
hands.left: hangs over the rail in START, open palm up beside the shoulder in END
